user.title: Follow an NHL team
user.description: Pick the team to track. Add the integration again to follow more teams.

abort.already_configured: This team is already being followed.
abort.all_configured: Every team is already being followed.

data.track_opponent: Fire opponent goal and penalty events

data_description.live_interval: Seconds between play-by-play checks during a game. Lower is faster but uses more requests.
data_description.alert_delay: Hold every event this many seconds so the horn matches your TV or stream, which runs behind the live data.
data_description.game_soon_minutes: Minutes before puck drop to fire game_soon.
data_description.game_day_hour: Local hour (0-23) on game day to fire game_day.
data_description.track_opponent: Turn off to only get events for your own team.
data_description.api_base_url: Leave as default. Change only for testing against a mock server.

simulate_event.name: Simulate event
simulate_event.description: Fire a sample event so you can test automations without waiting for a game. Respects the Game alerts switch.

config_entry_id.name: Team
config_entry_id.description: Team to fire for. Leave empty for all followed teams.

scorer_name.name: Scorer name
scorer_name.description: Optional scorer name for goal events.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the latest schedule, standings and game data now.

config_entry_id.name: Team
config_entry_id.description: Team to refresh. Leave empty for all.

play_highlight.name: Play goal video
play_highlight.description: Play an NHL goal video on media players, or return its stream URL. Without a clip ID it plays the latest goal video posted for your teams. Videos are posted about 5 minutes (short clip) and 9 minutes (full highlight) after a goal.

entity_id.name: Media players
entity_id.description: Where to play the video. Leave empty to only get the stream URL in the response.

config_entry_id.name: Team
config_entry_id.description: Use this team's latest goal video. Leave empty for any followed team.

clip_id.name: Clip ID
clip_id.description: NHL clip ID from a goal_highlight event (clip_id). Leave empty for the latest.

format.name: Format
format.description: mp4 (720p file, works on most players) or hls (adaptive stream).
